title: Define sign-off choreography and gated handoff lanes for PRD scope variance
creator: Priya Malhotra
description: Establish a lightweight, enforceable sign-off choreography for PRD scope changes that creates three gated handoff lanes (minor, substantive, regulatory) and a deterministic acceptance checklist so engineering, design, and legal can approve changes within defined SLAs. Deliverables: runbook, PRD change template, checklist, owner matrix, and sample canary acceptance plan.
background: We frequently see one-off signoffs causing delays and rework when PRD scope shifts mid-cycle. This ticket defines an executable choreography to reduce latency and clarify ownership while preserving legal and privacy safeguards. Pilot with Private Upgrade PRD.
acceptance_criteria: Documented runbook with lane definitions and owner matrix published in Confluence
SLA targets agreed: 48h design review for minor, 72h engineering review for substantive, 5 business days legal for regulatory changes
Checklist items for each lane (artifact set) defined and linked to PRD template
Three pilot PRDs (private-upgrade, dedicated-autoscale, structured-output) successfully use the choreography and record time-to-signoff improvements
Automated check: PRD change submissions require checklist attachment before assignment in Linear
decisions: Adopt three-lane model (minor/substantive/regulatory) to limit legal burden on small UI copy edits
Design reviews will default to asynchronous feedback unless designer marks "synchronous required"
Engineering acceptance must include a minimal integration smoke test and estimated rollforward plan
Legal will use a fast-track clause for data residency exceptions where mitigations are present
tradeoffs_and_risks: Stricter gating reduces rework but may increase initial friction and calendar waits
Short SLAs risk superficial reviews; mitigation: checklist enforces required artifacts
Consequence management for missed SLAs: automatic escalation to product director after SLA ticket
Potential need for legal headcount during peak regulatory review windows
